method.zh: 逐筆核對 ITTF、WTT 與 ETTU 官方比賽報導與賽果；少數以 Hugo 本人官方賽果表補足日期或比分。以日期、賽事、對戰球員去重，完整影片和精華不重複計數。目前 11 組均是選取的已驗證樣本，沒有取得可證明完整範圍的生涯 H2H 總表。歷史樣本勝率只描述這些比賽；未來數值由另頁透明探索模型計算，不是官方預測。
method.en: ITTF, WTT and ETTU official reports/results are checked match by match; Calderano’s official player log supplies a few missing dates or scores. Date, event and players identify one match, so full matches and highlights are not double-counted. All 11 pairings are selective verified samples: no complete career H2H table with established coverage was obtained. Sample win rates describe these records only; future estimates come from a separately explained exploratory model, not an official forecast.

evidenceLimits.zh: 目前只有一場可核對結果，樣本太少；不作完整交手或球風優劣結論。
evidenceLimits.en: Only one result is currently verified. The sample is too small for complete head-to-head or stylistic conclusions.

evidenceLimits.zh: 2025 混合團體的技戰術賽報只作補充分析；因固定打三局，無論 2:1 或 3:0 都不是一般五局或七局制的同質勝負樣本。
evidenceLimits.en: The 2025 mixed-team tactical report is supplementary analysis only. Fixed three-game allocations are not pooled with ordinary best-of-five or best-of-seven singles results.
